body:
**`@object-ui/site` is out of scope here — it was never debt.** Measured rather than assumed, in #2924.

Its 7 `TS2304` errors on `LayoutProps` / `PageProps` / `RouteContext` were **entirely an artifact of never having built it**. `apps/site/tsconfig.json` includes `.next/types/**/*.ts`, which Next only generates during `next build`, and site is excluded from `pnpm build` (`--filter=!@object-ui/site`) — so the sweep type-checked a package whose generated types did not exist. Build it first and `tsc --noEmit` is **exit 0, zero errors**.

It also does not need a `type-check` script at all: `next build` type-checks by default (`apps/site/next.config.mjs` does not set `typescript.ignoreBuildErrors`), and the `docs` CI job runs that build. #2924 moves it to a new `CHECKED_BY_OWN_BUILD` category that *verifies* the exemption — adding `ignoreBuildErrors: true` fails the guard, so the exemption cannot silently rot into the #2911 hole.

Outstanding errors across this issue drop **32 → 25** accordingly. The remaining scope is unchanged: `plugin-form` (10), `plugin-grid` (4), `cli` (4), `plugin-designer` (1), `object-ui` (1) — plus `plugin-view` (#2916) and `layout` (#2918) tracked separately.

Also note `@object-ui/runner` is now done (#2922), so it is off the list too.
